findings.claim: All model and derivative revisions remained null despite accessible public metadata.
findings.resolution: Pinned four artifacts and cited immutable cards/configs throughout owned Markdown and model.json.

findings.claim: Gemma license provenance was limited to a derivative and the base remained unverified.
findings.resolution: Pinned Google card and live Google license page both identify Apache-2.0; base provenance now explicit.

findings.claim: Mistral recommendation wording said TP2/4 versus TP8 measured, and baseline_tp2 conflicted with the actual TP8 baseline profile.
findings.resolution: Removed implied measurement; baseline_tp=8 and TP2/4 clearly comparison probes; root must propagate catalog.

findings.claim: Mistral SGLang support was left unknown despite direct publisher and engine documentation.
findings.resolution: Documented exact upstream SGLang support; retained untested local-image probe status and parser gates.

findings.claim: Mistral config-fix source duplicated the main config and the corrected field was absent from projection.
findings.resolution: Linked actual correction commit; added mscale_all_dim=0.0, mscale=1.0, beta_fast=4.0, beta_slow=1.0.

findings.claim: Mistral license was only described as custom/other.
findings.resolution: Named Modified MIT and summarized the material revenue restriction with pinned LICENSE citation.

findings.claim: Mistral exact selected-layout bytes were unresolved although both index files are public.
findings.resolution: Recorded each metadata.total_size=133605834656 bytes; excluded headers/runtime and avoided summing alternate layouts as one model.

findings.claim: Downloading both Mistral layouts was said to necessarily double startup transfer.
findings.resolution: Distinguished download/storage totals from which files a runtime actually reads.

findings.claim: Mistral analogy suggested re-running the full manuscript every decode step.
findings.resolution: Explained consulting cached keys/values across history.

findings.claim: Gemma quantization discussion lacked exact artifact-size evidence.
findings.resolution: Added pinned tree file totals; 2.688x BF16/NVFP4 ratio is file metadata arithmetic, not a runtime saving.

findings.claim: Core architecture dimensions, Gemma audio exclusion and Mistral88GiB BF16-KV calculation.
findings.resolution: Verified, retained, clarified assumptions; no basis to label these claims fabricated.
